title: Transversal non-Clifford gates on almost-good quantum LDPC and quantum locally testable codes
summary: We exhibit nontrivial transversal logical multi-controlled-$Z$ gates on $[\![N,Θ(N),\tildeΘ(N)]\!]$ quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes with soundness $\tildeΘ(1)$, combining nearly optimal code parameters with fault-tolerant non-Clifford gates on qLDPC and quantum locally testable codes for the first time. Remarkably, our proofs proceed through highly general algebraic arguments.
